description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for Capgo: manage apps, bundles, channels and progressive rollouts, devices, statistics and Observe, native builds, webhooks and push notifications, and search the Capgo docs.
instructions: Connect to https://api.capgo.app/mcp with Streamable HTTP. Sign in with OAuth, or send `Authorization: Bearer <Capgo API key>`. Start with capgo_whoami and capgo_list_apps, and use capgo_search_docs for documentation. To upload local bundle files or request native builds, run `npx @capgo/cli@latest mcp` after login.
